items.title: Four article choices inside possessive forms
items.caption: The rows track one or many and particular or non-specific. The two columns keep the *a*-word and *o*-word forms side by side.

items.title: Sort the belonging types
items.intro: Place each printed word under the belonging type this chapter gives it.

bins.label: *a*-words
bins.hint: mostly got, made, or taken on

bins.label: *o*-words
bins.hint: mostly given rather than set up

items.why: A head is part of the person, and parts of the body take *o*.
A thing's own quality is given rather than set up.
A house lived in is the place its owner belongs to.
A spoon is got and used.
A radio is got and put to use.
A friend is among the people taken into a life.
A spouse is taken on rather than given by birth.

items.intro: Use number and specificity to place each printed form.
